rows.text: Global search keeps entries with no age limit by default. The daily prune still caps the index at 300,000 rows (oldest first). Set web.search.retention_days in fleet.yaml (1–3650 days, or 0 for no age limit); it takes effect at the next fleet start.
全域搜尋預設不限天數。每日清理仍會把索引上限維持在 30 萬筆（先刪最舊的）。在 fleet.yaml 設定 web.search.retention_days（1–3650 天，或 0 代表不限天數），下次啟動 fleet 後生效。
